lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 집 보러 왔어요. 오래된 집이네요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I came to see the house. It's an old house, isn't it?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. jip boreo wasseoyo. oraedoen jibineyo?
lines.learner: 네, 지은 지 오십 년 됐어요. 기둥은 아직 튼튼해요.
lines.en: Yes, it was built 50 years ago. The pillars are still sturdy.
lines.roman: ne, jieun ji osip nyeon dwaesseoyo. gidungeun ajik teunteunhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The pillars are wood. What are the walls made of?
lines.learner: 벽은 시멘트예요. 오래되고 해서 조금 갈라졌어요.
lines.en: The walls are cement. Partly because they're old, they cracked a bit.
lines.roman: byeogeun simenteuyeyo. oraedoego haeseo jogeum gallajyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about the floor? It looks a bit cold.
lines.learner: 겨울에는 춥고 해서 방바닥을 새로 고쳤어요.
lines.en: Partly because winters are cold, I redid the floor.
lines.roman: gyeoureneun chupgo haeseo bangbadageul saero gochyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, the windows are big. It's nice and bright.
lines.en: Yes, but in exchange, it's a bit cold in winter.

lines.beaver_en: Then don't you plan to replace the windows?
lines.learner: 바꾸고 싶은데 비싸고 해서 아직 못 바꿨어요.
lines.en: I want to, but partly because it's expensive, I haven't yet.
lines.roman: bakkugo sipeunde bissago haeseo ajik mot bakkwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I understand. The living room floor is wood?
lines.en: Yes, it's a wooden floor. It's a bit old but clean.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a door on the kitchen side too?
lines.learner: 네, 부엌에 뒷문이 있어요. 마당으로 나갈 수 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, there's a back door in the kitchen. It leads to the yard.
lines.roman: ne, bueoke dwinmuni isseoyo. madangeuro nagal su isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Why are you selling this house?
lines.learner: 아이들이 이사 가고 해서 집이 너무 넓어요.
lines.en: Partly because my kids moved out, the house is too big.
lines.roman: aideuri isa gago haeseo jibi neomu neolbeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. With so much to fix, it must be a hassle.
lines.learner: 조금요. 그래도 햇빛이 잘 들고 해서 살기 좋아요.
lines.en: A little. Still, partly because it's sunny, it's nice to live in.
lines.roman: jogeumnyo. geuraedo haetbichi jal deulgo haeseo salgi joayo.

lines.beaver: 네, 마음에 들어요. 가족이랑 다시 올게요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, I like it. I'll come back with my family.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, maeume deureoyo. gajogirang dasi olgeyo.
lines.en: Sure, come anytime. I'll wait for your call.
